changelog: Corrective release built directly for v1.3.20; the failed v1.3.21 app.php text patch is skipped.
Settings is redesigned as a clean compact menu. Theme, Admin Account, System Update, Version History, App & Device and System Data open only when tapped.
Upcoming Calendar indicator is yellow instead of red.
Past / saved Open Play schedules are clickable and show completed games, players, scores, winners, timestamps and match duration.
Admin login is securely remembered on the same device for up to 30 days; explicit Logout revokes it.
